title: Raw-active p90 common-differential device-wise P&V canary
hypothesis: The frozen assignment-84001 population can execute boundary-conditioned independent-device one-pulse program-and-verify for the seven-level p90 common-differential mapper without a non-finite endpoint or hidden reference use.
motivation: This operational canary checks the newly versioned raw-active coordinate and controller before any learning-rate screen or production training. It is not scientific evidence about accuracy or on-chip recovery.

arms.description: Zero optimizer updates and one exact development-array quantized deployment evaluated on two validation minibatches.

completion_criteria: Use raw-active zero-update checkpoint SHA-256 97785347e39bfaf14026dc06bf8b28a7e0e30711543e7a566baf915022c860d5, teacher SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52, and device-model SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3.
The mapping must contain 39,700 quads, exactly 35,730 structurally eligible quads, D90=0.10354409442884083, one within-quad baseline, seven global differential levels, and no reference consumption.

Condition every cell from raw a=0 with RESET pulses until four consecutive raw-state changes below 2e-6 or the 4096-pulse cap, then independently program only structurally and exactly supported cells with the one-pulse controller and a 128-pulse target budget.

Persist conditioning, target-programming, apparent and persistent endpoint, eligibility, tolerance, population, and RNG-continuation fields. Retain the 10-percent unsupported cells as explicit structural failures.
The canary passes operationally only with finite endpoints for all cells and a complete run receipt. No accuracy threshold is attached to this two-minibatch canary.
analysis_plan: Report structural, exact-support, conditioning-success, programming-eligible, apparent-accepted, and accepted-persistent-within-tolerance counts separately.
Report RESET conditioning pulses separately from SET/RESET target-programming pulses, verify reads, reversals, and budget exhaustion.
Do not interpret this canary as a comparison of continuous HWA, QAT, or on-chip training.
